skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze general information about the internship unit (formation process, development, organizational structure, functions, tasks of the unit, main production and business activities, product/service characteristics, business environment of the internship unit)
Analyze the operational situation of production and business activities, characteristics of the internship unit, activities, roles, responsibilities of the legal department of the internship unit
Conduct preliminary analysis of legal activities of the internship unit, development orientation of the internship unit
Identify research problems within the legal field of the internship unit
Develop research proposals for selected topics
Select and build theoretical frameworks for research problems
Select and use research methods to implement the chosen research topic
Evaluate the current status of research problems based on the analysis of relevant data types
Propose solutions to address/improve research problems of the internship unit
Demonstrate independent work skills, analytical synthesis, and problem-solving skills
Demonstrate research skills, presentation skills, writing reports on specialized issues in the legal field
